blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–In another last-minute shakeup at the Singapore Open, American World No. 11 Amanda Anisimova became the latest star to pull out of the WTA 500 event. The second-seeded Anisimova withdrew on Tuesday due to a left wrist injury. Her withdrawal came just two days after Indonesian ace Janice Tjen dropped out because of a right wrist injury. The absence of Anisimova, along with other top players like Jessica Pegula, Diana Shnaider and Sorana Cirstea, has cleared the way for Alex Eala to win a second WTA 500 crown after she ruled the DC Open over a month ago.
